arxiv-2101-02170.title: Relic density of dark matter in the inert doublet model beyond leading order for the low mass region: 4. The Higgs resonance region Preprint: LAPTH-004/21, CERN-TH-2021-004
arxiv-2101-02170.creator: Shankha Banerjee, ​​, Fawzi Boudjema, ​​, Nabarun Chakrabarty, ​​, Hao Sun
arxiv-2101-02170.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shankha Banerjee, ​​, Fawzi Boudjema, ​​, Nabarun Chakrabarty, ​​, Hao Sun. One-loop electroweak corrections to the annihilation cross-sections of dark matter in the Higgs resonance region of the inert doublet model (IDM) are investigated. The procedure of how to implement the width of the Higgs in order to regularise the amplitude both at tree-level and at one-loop together with the renormalisation of a key parameter of the model, are thoroughly scrutinised.

arxiv-2202-00082.title: Trust Region Bounds for Decentralized PPO Under Non-stationarity Conference: Proc. of the 22nd International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2023); May 29 – June 2, 2023; London, United Kingdom 587
arxiv-2202-00082.creator: Mingfei Sun, Sam Devlin, Jacob Beck, Katja Hofmann, Shimon Whiteson
arxiv-2202-00082.description: Abstract . We present trust region bounds for optimizing decentralized policies in cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), which holds even when the transition dynamics are non-stationary. This new analysis provides a theoretical understanding of the strong performance of two recent actor-critic methods for MARL, which both rely on independent ratios , i.e., computing probability ratios separately for each agent’s policy.

arxiv-2509-06765.title: Rates of convergence in long time asymptotics of an alignment model with symmetry breaking
arxiv-2509-06765.creator: Alexandre Surin Ceremade (CNRS UMR n o 7534), PSL University, Université Paris-Dauphine, Place de Lattre de Tassigny, 75775 Paris 16, France Email: surin@ceremade.dauphine.fr
arxiv-2509-06765.description: Abstract . We consider a nonlinear Fokker-Planck equation derived from a Cucker-Smale model for flocking with noise. There is a known phase transition depending on the noise between a regime with a unique stationary solution which is isotropic (symmetry) and a regime with a continuum of polarized stationary solutions (symmetry breaking).

arxiv-2510-16379.title: Stacking-tunable multiferroic states in bilayer ScI 2
arxiv-2510-16379.creator: Yaxin Pan 1 , Chongze Wang 2 , Shuyuan Liu 2 , Fengzhu Ren 1 , Chang Liu 1 , Bing Wang 1∗ , and Jun-Hyung Cho 1,2∗
arxiv-2510-16379.description: Abstract Two-dimensional (2D) multiferroic materials hold significant promise for advancing the miniaturization and integration of nanodevices. In this study, we demonstrate that 2D bilayer ScI 2 , which exhibits ferromagnetic (FM) ordering within each layer, enables the tuning of interlayer magnetic coupling, ferroelectricity, and valley polarization through interlayer sliding and rotation.

Weatherford, Sarah Pearson, Nondh Panithanpaisal. Globular cluster stellar streams probe galaxy-formation processes and can potentially reveal the distribution of dark matter in galaxies. In many theoretical studies, streams are modeled with particle-spray or direct N N -body codes.

britannica-1911-torricelli-evangelista.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-torricelli-evangelista.description: Article 'Torricelli, Evangelista' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 27), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The publication amongst Torricelli’s Opera geometrica (Florence, 1644) of a tract on the properties of the cycloid involved him in a controversy with G. de Roberval, who accused him of plagiarizing his earlier solution of the problem of its quadrature. There seems, however, no room for doubt that Torricelli’s was arrived at independently.

pmc-10595421.title: Overall effectiveness of PRALIMAP-INES in reducing adolescents’ nutritional and weight inequalities
pmc-10595421.creator: A Dosda, F Manneville, A Omorou
pmc-10595421.description: BackgroundThe PRALIMAP-INES trial was effective in reducing weight social inequalities among adolescents with overweight or obesity. Nevertheless, the question of its overall effectiveness on weight status and nutritional behaviours (NB) remains unclear. This study aims to evaluate the overall effect of the PRALIMAP-INES trial on weight status and NB among adolescents with overweight or obesity .

pmc-10702126.title: Association of systemic immune inflammatory index with all-cause and cause-specific mortality among individuals with type 2 diabetes
pmc-10702126.creator: Chaoyang Chen, Yuwen Chen, Qiyue Gao, Qucheng Wei
pmc-10702126.description: BackgroundThe evidence regarding the association between the systemic immune inflammatory index (SII) and mortality among individuals with diabetes is limited. This study aims to evaluate the associations between SII and all-cause and cause-specific mortality among individuals with diabetes.MethodsThe study included 8,668 participants with diabetes from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 1999–2018 with follow-up until 31 December 2019.

pmc-11410455.title: A Case Report on a Syndesmotic Ankle Injury Treated With Arthrex TightRope
pmc-11410455.creator: Amit Kale, Vishal S Patil, Abhishek Nair, Mohammed Talha Muneer
pmc-11410455.description: Syndesmotic ankle injuries, often referred to as "high ankle sprains," pose intricate challenges in orthopedic practice, particularly among athletes engaged in high-impact sports. Conventional treatments have encompassed conservative approaches and the use of syndesmotic screws, each beset by inherent limitations.

pmc-11417267.title: Assessment of antioxidant and antibacterial efficacy of some indigenous vegetables consumed by the Manipuri community in Sylhet, Bangladesh
pmc-11417267.creator: Mukta Roy, Jahid Hasan Shourove, Rhythm Singha, Tawkir Ahmed Tonmoy, Gokul Chandra Biswas, Fariha Chowdhury Meem, Parvej Hasan John, Mitu Samadder, Md Azmain Al Faik
pmc-11417267.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The rapid dietary changes experienced by indigenous people worldwide threaten the use of traditional foods, which are often undervalued. This study focused on evaluating the antioxidant and antibacterial efficacy of five vegetables typically consumed by the Manipuri ethnic groups in the Sylhet region of Bangladesh: Yongchak seed (Parkia speciosa), Telikadam seed (Leucaena leucocephala), Phakphai leaf (Persicaria odorata), Sheuli leaf (Nyctanthes arbor-tristis), and bamboo shoot (Bambusa spp.).

pmc-12441601.title: Theory of infectious disease spillover at an ecological boundary: impacts of seasonality and cross-boundary movement
pmc-12441601.creator: Kaniz Fatema Nipa, Mozzamil Mohammed, P. Stephens, John M. Drake
pmc-12441601.description: Ecological boundaries are a key site for the spillover of wildlife pathogens into human and domestic livestock populations. Ebola virus is a zoonotic pathogen that is periodically introduced into humans causing outbreaks of a highly fatal haemorrhagic disease. There is evidence that spillover risk varies seasonally.

pmc-12495132.title: Diagnosing and Managing Pelizaeus‐Merzbacher Disease: A Pediatric Struggle
pmc-12495132.creator: Sajjad Ahmed Khan, Naphibanroi Lamar, Ishan Shrestha, Sagar Bhagat
pmc-12495132.description: Prompt diagnosis of rare genetic conditions like Pelizaeus‐Merzbacher Disease enables timely care. Coordinated, multidisciplinary support and proactive prevention, particularly of issues like aspiration pneumonia, are vital to enhancing quality of life and outcomes, even as the disease continues to progress.

pmc-12790185.title: Concomitant Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy in Patients With Multiple Myeloma
pmc-12790185.creator: Mohamed Ibrahim, Rashid Alhusain, J. Christopher Ray, Melissa A. Lyle, Juan C. Leoni Moreno, Nabeel Aslam, Jose N. Nativi Nicolau, Grace Lin, Taimur Sher, Awais Malik
pmc-12790185.description: BackgroundCardiac amyloidosis is a restrictive cardiomyopathy caused by myocardial deposition of insoluble amyloid fibrils. The 2 most frequent types are transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) and light-chain amyloid cardiomyopathy (AL-CM). AL-CM is a type of plasma cell dyscrasia characterized by overproduction of light chains by a plasma cell clone.

pmc-13655878.title: Ethical dilemmas and intervention strategies in doctor-patient-family communication in end-of-life pediatric oncology: a narrative review
pmc-13655878.creator: Ju Zheng, Danni Lv, Yiyao Bao
pmc-13655878.description: Background and ObjectiveCommunication in end-of-life pediatric oncology involves ethically sensitive exchanges among healthcare providers, children, and families. The main dilemmas include how to disclose prognosis without abandoning hope, how to balance parents’ surrogate authority with the child’s evolving participation, and how to align treatment decisions with family values, developmental capacity, and the child’s best interests.

uslaw-usc-t31-s9309.title: 31 U.S.C. § 9309 — Priority of sureties
uslaw-usc-t31-s9309.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t31-s9309.description: United States Code, Title 31 (Money And Finance); Chapter 93 (Sureties And Surety Bonds). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. When a person required to provide a surety bond given to the United States Government is insolvent or dies having assets insufficient to pay debts, the surety, or the executor, administrator, or assignee of the surety paying the Government the amount due under.
